effect_details.reason: The bundled Omega constant/API corpus exposes no effect code that changes Link Rating. The printed Link Rating branch cannot be implemented faithfully in this runtime.

effect_details.clause: Special Summon from the GY while a monster has a reduced Level, Rank, or Link Rating, then banish this card when it leaves.
effect_details.implementation: The reduced-value condition covers Level and Rank, and the summon applies EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT; the Link Rating condition is necessarily absent.
